2608.28241.title: Beyond Task-Only Matching: Personalized Skill Routing with Counterfactual Evaluation
2608.28241.paper_summary: The rapid expansion of reusable skill repositories makes skill routing a critical capability for large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods treat routing as task-only semantic matching. However, when users with incompatible constraints issue an identical request, this assumption conflates task relevance with skill suitability: a task-only router can select a semantically plausible skill that is unsuitable for the requesting user. To expose this failure mode, we formulate \textit{personalized skill routing} as profile-conditioned retrieval, in which relevance depends jointly on the task and the user profile. We first introduce a profile-counterfactual benchmark, in which the task is held fixed while changes in the user profile induce changes in the reference skill. We further construct paired counterfactual supervision and propose SkillFeed, a progressive retrieve-and-rerank framework that first establishes task--skill alignment and then learns profile-conditioned discrimination. By retrieving body-level evidence and reranking semantically similar but profile-conflicting candidates, SkillFeed identifies skills that satisfy both task requirements and user constraints. On SkillFeed-Bench, SkillFeed attains 75.1\% top-1 retrieval accuracy, a 23.1-point improvement over the corresponding pretrained routing baseline. Adding profile conditioning yields a 35.1-point gain on queries where user profile changes the reference skill. This contrast shows that user profiles are most consequential precisely when they change skill suitability. Our website is publicly available at http://www.aiskillfeed.com .
2608.28241.paper_summary_zh: 可重複使用技能庫的快速擴展使得技能路由成為大型語言模型（LLM）代理的重要能力。現有的方法將路由視為僅基於任務的語義匹配。然而，當具有不相容約束的用戶發出相同的請求時，這一假設將任務相關性與技能適用性混為一談：僅基於任務的路由器可能會選擇一個在語義上合理但對請求用戶不適用的技能。為了揭示這一失效模式，我們將\textit{個性化技能路由}公式化為基於檔案的檢索，其中相關性共同依賴於任務和用戶檔案。我們首先介紹一個檔案反事實基準，其中任務保持不變，而用戶檔案的變化引起參考技能的變化。我們進一步構建配對的反事實監督，並提出SkillFeed，這是一個漸進式檢索和重新排序框架，首先建立任務與技能的對齊，然後學習基於檔案的區分。通過檢索體級證據並重新排序語義上相似但與檔案衝突的候選者，SkillFeed識別滿足任務要求和用戶約束的技能。在SkillFeed-Bench上，SkillFeed達到了75.1\%的頂級檢索準確率，比對應的預訓練路由基準提高了23.1個百分點。添加檔案條件使得在用戶檔案改變參考技能的查詢中獲得了35.1個百分點的增益。這一對比顯示，當用戶檔案改變技能適用性時，其影響最為顯著。我們的網站可在http://www.aiskillfeed.com公開訪問。
